messages:
maria: quick sync about saved-views: we need a clear model for per-route vs per-model pins. do we store duplicates or one record with a scope?
cheng: one record + scope enum is cleaner. avoids stale duplicates when a view is edited.
ike: agree but UX must be explicit: when on a route page show the route-scoped pin if present, else fall back to model, else org default.
sam: also want saved-view editor to show telemetry sampling and an estimated cost preview. users should see expected token burn and "fallback" cost when routing policies may hit cheaper variants.
maria: API sketch: POST /api/console/saved_views with fields name, filters, scope (route|model|org), sampling_rate (optional), cost_preview (boolean). default sampling inherits workspace-level value.
cheng: migration: old views with no scope -> mark org and surface a migration banner that prompts owner to review sampling.
ike: rollout plan: behind flag console.savedviews.v2; enable for staging + internal, migrate 5% of views, monitor sampling drift and fetch p95. gate thresholds: sampling drift > 2% or cost_preview errors > 1% -> rollback.
maria: deploy-bot -- can we create a 5% rollout target group?
deploy-bot: featureflag console.savedviews.v2 exists. can target by org list or percentage via /internal/flags. last status check 1764032140.
sam: action items: cheng implements API + migration script; ike impl cost preview with routing fallback calc; sam mocks preview UI (primary vs "fallback" columns); maria writes rollout + gating doc.
maria: ok, loop back when PRs are ready. thanks :thumbsup:
